initial.prompt: Create a finished seamless TILEABLE square base-color texture for wet asphalt in the game 猫国志, a dark rainy cyberpunk cat-city street. Full canvas must be only a flat ground material seen exactly from above, orthographic, no perspective, no horizon, no scene, no props, no poster, no frame, no labels, no typography, no logo, no people or faces. Aim for a 2048x2048 native working texture to export at 1024x1024. TRUE FOUR-EDGE PERIODICITY: left matches right, top matches bottom, including water, grain, faded paint and oil; patterns that reach any edge continue naturally from the opposite edge. Do not introduce edge borders, tile outlines, mirrored quadrants or a centered symmetric repeat. Very dark charcoal with subtle desaturated blue-violet wet undertones, small broken asphalt aggregate grain, broad low-contrast damp zones and a few irregular shallow puddles. Oil traces are thin subdued brown-violet iridescent films. Keep pooled water distinct from grain by smoother texture and softly blurred, restrained cold-gray/cyan reflections, not neon stripes or an entire city reflected in the ground. No bright hard directional lighting, lamp shadows, raised 3D bevels or sunny illumination. A gently painterly believable material consistent with miniature cyberpunk scenery, not a glossy product photo. Puddles, worn road paint and oil must look like weathered surface features, not decorative stickers. No big focal centerpiece. Use the entire square, opaque background. Composition variant A: two or three small fragmented shallow puddles, fine cracked dark aggregate, one short isolated ghost of an off-white painted road-marking dash with missing chips, not readable letters or symbols. Preserve spacious mostly plain asphalt between features. Ensure the faded marking stays low-contrast enough for game characters to stand over it.
